_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score moved ±2 in only 3% of recent 12h windows and FLAT rule is active—no proven breaker—so the Denial rung holds.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD Denial; narrative bullish on flows but does not call a phase break or directional exit from the coil
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear stays mid-20s to mid-30s, funding non-negative, BTC remains inside a tight range over the next 1-2 sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: Liquidation flush drives fear under ~15 with funding negative (down to Panic), or squeeze lifts fear through ~40 with 30d momentum turning up (up to Anxiety)
